title: refactor(objectql): move the validation-message i18n helpers out of engine.ts into engine-validation-messages.ts (#25522 cut 1)
body:
Part of #25522
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6348891160

Cut 1 of the `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). The claim is `6382124735`. Three `ObjectQL` method bodies move unedited into a new module, `packages/objectql/src/engine-validation-messages.ts`: the validation-message localisation helpers `validationMessageContext`, `negotiatedMessageLocale` and `objectDisplayLabel` (all private). `setI18nService`, the public setter of the field they read, stays in the class: it is a two-line field write, and moving it would grow the class rather than shrink it.

It is move-only, and the card stays open for the later cuts. Branch `claude/issue-25522-objectql-engine-cut-1`, cut from `origin/main` at `e649c2d91e`; `main` has not moved since.

**Serial with the file's in-flight PRs.** At start, none of the 12 open PRs touched `packages/objectql/**` (each PR's file list read). Re-measured just before this PR was opened, on all 14 open PRs: none touches `packages/objectql/**`.

## Why this area for cut 1

The fresh seam table below has six areas with zero or one line from the last 30 days. This one is the only one that meets every series limit and has no path reader outside `packages/objectql`:

- **Roll-up summaries** (0 lines in 30 days) was the first candidate. Two things rule it out for a first cut. `recomputeSummaries` has an engine write (`this.update(`) and hands `this` to `aggregateSummaryValue`, so it would have to stay. And every `summaryOperations` mention in `engine.ts` sits in `buildSummaryIndex`, which the liveness ledger `packages/spec/liveness/field.json` cites as evidence by path, so moving it pulls a `packages/spec` edit into the slice.
- **Lifecycle init and health** and **Datasource routing** carry the inferred-return members `init` and `setDatasourceMapping`, which must stay.
- **Datasource registry** has three `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(` sites (the `UNTYPED_RECEIVERS` limit).
- **Validation-message i18n** (122 lines, 0 from the last 30 days): no public member moves, no inferred return type, no write call of any kind, no static, and its only readers are prose mentions.

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as #25222, #25223, #25224 and #25467 apply it)

- The class keeps each method with its name, signature, docblock and position, because tsup emits members with their JSDoc into the `.d.ts`. Each body is now one host literal plus `fn.call(host, …)`, marked `[#25522 cut 1]`. `objectDisplayLabel` reads no member and is called directly.
- `ValidationMessageHost` is new. It types every member as the class member itself (`ObjectQL['i18nService']`, `ObjectQL['negotiatedMessageLocale']`). Each moved function types its `this` as the `Pick` of the host over exactly the members its body reads, and the stub annotates its literal as the `ThisParameterType` of the moved function. No cast, and no member becomes public or protected.
- `negotiatedMessageLocale` goes in as a late-bound closure (`(...a) => this.negotiatedMessageLocale(...a)`), so a spy or double set on the instance is still the one `validationMessageContext` reaches.
- The one field read, `i18nService`, goes as a getter. That includes the read inside the `translate` closure, which runs after `validationMessageContext` has returned and still sees whatever service is installed at call time, as before.
- **Imports.** The module imports `ObjectQL` as a TYPE only, so there is no module cycle at run time. It imports `objectLabelKey` and `resolveBundleLocale` from `@objectstack/spec/system`, the specifier `engine.ts` used. Those two names had no other reader in `engine.ts`, so they leave its import list: that is the only edit outside the class besides the new module import. Nothing re-exports the module.

## The published `.d.ts` does not change

`@objectstack/objectql` emits six declaration files: `index`, `core` and a shared chunk `util-ByiLm3B6` (where `declare class ObjectQL` lives), each as `.d.ts` (CJS) and `.d.mts` (ESM). The chunk name is the same at base and head. All six are **byte-identical**, and the raw diff of each is 0 lines:

The normaliser, verbatim from the ruling, run on each file:

```sh
node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8");process.stdout.write(s.replace(/"[^"\n]*"(?:\s*\|\s*"[^"\n]*")+/g,r=>r.split(/\s*\|\s*/).sort().join(" | ")))' dist/util-ByiLm3B6.d.ts | sha256sum
```

- **Normalised = raw on every file, and this is expected.** This package's declarations print string literals in single quotes: the chunk holds 23 single-quoted literal unions and 0 double-quoted ones. So the ruling's normaliser, which matches only double quotes, changes nothing here. This cut does not depend on it, because the raw bytes are identical. A later cut of this file would, though; see "For the next dispatch" below.
- **Positive control** on a copy of the head `util-ByiLm3B6.d.ts`: line 7261 `private objectDisplayLabel;` made public (`objectDisplayLabel;`, one line differs) gives raw = normalised `270f913f734273e380af6ab964e8b15206aa7c511892dea58cc8f6fd9adf5ef7`, which differs from `1742a9cb…`.
- **Export lists**, loaded at runtime from the built bundles (`import()` of `dist/*.mjs`, `require` of `dist/*.js`), are identical at base and head: `.` exports 182 names under ESM and 182 under CJS, and `./core` exports 54 and 54. The sorted lists hash `881616cc179189098182bd6b8a95701d9922f9677b786bc12e2d31c1adb0adaa` (`.`) and `393e806906e876c2e020aa96617d54050a35ae63cd483b67d8e968b7b5390f49` (`./core`) at both ends.

No changeset: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160` item 4.

## Proof of move-only

- **Bodies, by AST token** (recursive `getChildren` leaves): each moved function's parameters (less the added `this`), return type and body have the same token sequence as the base method, and each body line is the base line with two leading spaces removed. 371 tokens compared, 0 differ. Negative control: one changed token in `negotiatedMessageLocale` makes the check report a difference.
- **Class side**: the class has 317 members at base and head. The 314 members that did not move are byte-identical to base. Each of the 3 stubs keeps its docblock and signature byte-identical.
- **Top level of `engine.ts`**: 232 of the 233 statements outside the class are byte-identical. The other is the `@objectstack/spec/system` import, less `objectLabelKey` and `resolveBundleLocale`. The one new statement is the import of the new module.
- **Size**: +135 / -39 over 2 files, under the 3,000-line manual-merge line. `engine.ts` goes from 23,903 to 23,881 lines. Each stub keeps its docblock and carries its host literal, so the file shrinks by less than the bodies' length. `engine-validation-messages.ts` has 118 lines.
- **The tests reach the moved body**: a one-off mutation of the moved `negotiatedMessageLocale` (its `resolveBundleLocale(...)` return replaced by `return requested;`, written with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`) turns `engine-validation-locale-negotiation.test.ts` red, 3 failed / 3 passed. It was restored to the HEAD blob `5d9194fa75bb` with `git diff HEAD` empty, and no test file was kept.

## Readers of the moved lines

- **ADR anchors.** `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__objectql__src__engine.ts.json` carries one paragraph, on the transaction seam (ADR-0057, ADR-0067, ADR-0119), and none of it describes a moved body. The moved bodies cite no ADR (the ADR-0053 Phase 2 reference is in `validationMessageContext`'s docblock, which stays on the stub). So the new module owes no anchor entry, and none is added. `check:adr-anchors`: 84 → 84 anchored files; decision-letter citations on the anchored surface 1,883 → 1,883; 52,465 citations across 6,583 files at both ends.
- **Path readers of these symbols** (`git grep` repo-wide): none pins `engine.ts#validationMessageContext`, `#negotiatedMessageLocale` or `#objectDisplayLabel`. The mentions are prose: `plugin-approvals/src/reader-locale-labels.ts` and `service-automation/src/engine.ts` (by method name, which still resolves), and `spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` (`engine.ts`'s `setI18nService`, which did not move). `check-adr-symbol-anchors`: 2,384 anchors resolve at head.
- `core-boundary.ratchet.test.ts`: the new module joins the `/core` closure and imports only `@objectstack/spec/system`. It passes.

## For the next dispatch (cut 2)

- **Proposed area: Datasource routing**, less `setDatasourceMapping` (inferred return, stays) and the two public statics. That is `isSystemLedgerObject`, `getDriver`, `resolveDatasourceBinding`, `resolveEffectiveDatasource`, `resolveMappedDatasource`, `resolveDatasourceFromMapping` and `matchPattern`. Its 343 lines have 1 line from the last 30 days, no `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(` site and no private static. The anchor entry's paragraph names "the same tuple ADR-0057 §3.6 routing reads", so the new module would get its own anchor entry carrying it. Measure `getDriver`'s spies and doubles before choosing it.
- **The alternative, Roll-up summaries** (0 lines from the last 30 days), needs the `packages/spec/liveness/field.json` evidence pointer moved in the same slice, and `recomputeSummaries` stays.
- **A limit for every later cut.** This package's `.d.ts` prints literals in single quotes, so the ruling's verbatim normaliser cannot absorb a union-member-order swap here. A cut that moves a body checked before the rest of `engine.ts` and reorders a union would show a raw diff that the normaliser leaves in place. Under the ruling's item 1 that is a stop: the normaliser must not be widened. The decision is raised in the os-dev report on the card.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` and `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0. `eslint --no-inline-config packages/objectql`: exit 0.
- `packages/objectql` suite at head `328b5b194e` (`vitest run --project local`): 466 files, 8,700 tests, 8,700 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. The suites that pin these helpers (`engine-validation-locale.test.ts`, `engine-validation-locale-negotiation.test.ts`, `engine-delete-restricted-locale.test.ts`) are among them.
- Downstream type-checks are untouched by construction: every member moved is private, so no dependant can reach one, and all six published declaration files are byte-identical. CI's `TypeScript Type Check` covers the dependants.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 56 families on the real diff. Each was run at head, and its exit code was recorded and reconciled with `--ran` (56/56 accounted for). 53 exit 0. Three are NOT MEASURED locally, and CI runs them:
  - `check-engine-split-ratio --days 90` exit 2, CANNOT COMPUTE: the shallow clone's history starts 2026-09-15, inside the window.
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exit 3: the pinned fixture commit is unreachable from this shallow clone.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs every package's `dist/`. The export lists above are its question for this package.
- Hand gates at head, all exit 0: `check-adr-anchors`, `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-nul-bytes`, `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main`.
